title: Proof audit exercise
source:
Claim C001.
Let X_1,...,X_n be independent Uniform[0,1] random variables. Let D be independent of the whole sample.
Let f_D:[0,1]->[0,1] be jointly measurable in D and its argument. Write P f_D = integral_0^1 f_D(x) dx.
For every t > 0, P(|n^{-1} sum_{i=1}^n f_D(X_i) - P f_D| >= t) <= 2 exp(-2 n t^2).
Proof. Conditional on D, the function f_D is fixed and the X_i remain independent Uniform[0,1].
Hoeffding's inequality conditional on D bounds the displayed event by 2 exp(-2 n t^2).
Integrating the conditional bound over D proves the claim.

conclusions.claim: P(|P_n f_D - P f_D| >= t) <= 2 exp(-2 n t^2)
